name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
blurb: Costco Wholesale Corporation operates membership warehouses in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the UK, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Iceland, New Zealand, and Sweden. It offers a wide range of merchandise including groceries, electronics, health and beauty aids, hardware, sporting goods, and more. As of May 2026, Costco has a market cap of approximately $441.77 billion and is known for its low-price, high-volume retail model.
recent: In the past 30 days, COST stock traded in a range of $844.06–$1,067.08, closing at $995.75 on May 6, 2026. The ex-dividend date was May 1, 2026, for a $5.88 dividend. Analysts have a buy rating with a price target of $1,078.32, and the next earnings report is expected on May 28, 2026.
